protocol: cpu_v1 cached analysis and gpu_v2 supplementary accuracy studies
holm_family: all predeclared reference comparisons within task and study
rules_verbatim: "Difference supported": the 95% CI of the paired difference excludes 0 AND Holm-adjusted p < 0.05.
"Practically equivalent": the whole 95% CI lies within +/-0.01 macro-F1 (multiclass) or +/-0.002 macro-F1 (binary). These margins are conventions chosen in advance.

For the early-stopping hypothesis, report the B1 correlation and the B3 variance/mean comparison side by side; do not declare causality unless fixed-budget (arm b) shows both a visibly smaller macro-F1 SD and a higher mean for ExLightNet; otherwise say "not supported".
bootstrap_interpretation: Each replicate uniformly selects a training seed, then resamples test flows. This describes a randomly selected run plus finite-flow uncertainty, not the CI of the five-seed mean.
post_hoc_sensitivity: Exclude labels whose original test support is below 10 from macro averaging; retain all flows and their false-positive contributions. Not a replacement for macro-F1.
supplementary_latency: NOT RUN: current task forbids any benchmark rerun
